# BugOut

> BugOut: Offline Survival Kit is an iPhone app for emergency preparedness that works with no internet. It carries 68 field guides, including the U.S. Army Survival Manual (FM 21-76), plus Survival Essentials (the core method for 56 emergencies), 7 step-by-step disaster scenarios with gear checklists, your own gear lists, phone sensor tools, and Wally, an AI survival assistant that runs on the iPhone itself.

This file summarizes the BugOut website for AI assistants and search engines. The full text of every page is in [llms-full.txt](https://jaechung-glitch.github.io/bugout/llms-full.txt).

## Key facts

- What it is: An offline survival kit for iPhone: emergency preparedness guides, checklists and tools that work with no internet connection.
- Platform: iPhone with iOS 16 or later, on the U.S. App Store.
- Price: Free download. BugOut Pro is $6.99 a month or $54.99 a year.
- Works offline: Yes. Guides, checklists, scenarios and sensor tools work with no signal and no account. Only buying or restoring Pro needs a connection.
- What's inside: 68 field guides, including the U.S. Army Survival Manual (FM 21-76); Survival Essentials, the core method for 56 emergencies in 12 topics; 7 disaster scenarios with gear checklists.
- AI assistant: Ask Wally runs on the iPhone and shows the BugOut passages each answer is based on. Written answers need Apple Intelligence (iPhone 15 Pro or newer, iOS 26 or later). Part of BugOut Pro. Like any AI, it can make mistakes.
- Sources: U.S. military field manuals, the CDC, EPA, FEMA and Ready.gov, the American Red Cross, the National Weather Service and the National Park Service.
- Privacy: No account. Questions to Wally, your location and your lists stay on the phone; the only data collected is anonymous purchase history.

## The app

- [BugOut: offline survival app for iPhone](https://jaechung-glitch.github.io/bugout/): what the app does, Ask Wally, free vs Pro, and FAQ
- [BugOut on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6761040937): download page

## Survival guides

- [Emergency preparedness: how to prepare for any disaster](https://jaechung-glitch.github.io/bugout/guides/emergency-preparedness/): Emergency preparedness in three steps: make a household plan, build a kit and set up alerts. A plain disaster preparedness guide with checklists.
- [Emergency kit list: what to put in a home emergency kit](https://jaechung-glitch.github.io/bugout/guides/emergency-kit-list/): A printable emergency kit list based on FEMA's Ready.gov checklist: water, food, light, first aid, tools and documents, plus what to add for kids and pets.
- [How to prepare for a winter storm](https://jaechung-glitch.github.io/bugout/guides/how-to-prepare-for-a-winter-storm/): How to prepare for a winter storm: a printable checklist for your home, frozen pipes, power outages and your car, plus the signs of frostbite and hypothermia.
- [Car emergency kit: what to keep in your car](https://jaechung-glitch.github.io/bugout/guides/car-emergency-kit/): What to keep in a car emergency kit: a printable checklist built from NHTSA and Ready.gov guidance, winter add-ons, and what to do if you're stranded.
- [Bug out bag list: what to pack for 72 hours](https://jaechung-glitch.github.io/bugout/guides/bug-out-bag-list/): What to put in a bug out bag: a printable 72-hour checklist for water, food, shelter, first aid, tools and documents, built from FEMA and CDC guidance.
- [What to do when the power goes out](https://jaechung-glitch.github.io/bugout/guides/power-outage-checklist/): What to do when the power goes out: food safety times, generator and carbon monoxide rules, staying warm or cool, and a printable power outage checklist.
- [How to make water safe to drink](https://jaechung-glitch.github.io/bugout/guides/how-to-make-water-safe-to-drink/): How to purify water in an emergency or in the wild: how long to boil it, how much bleach per gallon (EPA table), filters, tablets and what no method can fix.
- [Emergency water calculator: how much water and food to store](https://jaechung-glitch.github.io/bugout/guides/emergency-water-calculator/): Work out how much emergency water and food your household needs for 3 days, a week or 2 weeks, using the CDC's gallon-a-day rule, with storage tips.
- [12 survival skills everyone should know](https://jaechung-glitch.github.io/bugout/guides/survival-skills/): The survival skills that matter most, in the order they save lives: priorities, staying found, signaling, shelter, fire, water, navigation and first aid.
- [Prepping for beginners: a 4-week starter plan](https://jaechung-glitch.github.io/bugout/guides/prepping-for-beginners/): Prepping for beginners without the doomsday stuff: know your local risks, store water and food, build a go bag, and get ready for outages, one week at a time.
- [Gifts for preppers: 18 practical ideas that get used](https://jaechung-glitch.github.io/bugout/guides/gifts-for-preppers/): Practical gift ideas for preppers and anyone building an emergency kit, based on FEMA's Build a Kit list: radios, lights, water, first aid, warmth and more.
- [Survival and prepping terms, explained](https://jaechung-glitch.github.io/bugout/guides/survival-terms/): What bug out bag, go bag, EDC, INCH bag, SHTF, shelter in place, watch vs warning and other survival and prepping terms mean, in plain English.
